local_performance_tests.purpose: Canonical registration, startup replay, swaps and test resets; coherent count points and collection under concurrent submission.
Original SDK tests plus ordinary/feature-tag metric equivalence across fresh clients.
Concurrent first use preserves internal filtering and third-party/customer classification.
Offset-based Testify lookup resolves the same suite method as reflection for methods, nested subtests, unmatched siblings and ordinary tests.
Coverage initialization starts no go list; the first module reader resolves it once, from the initialization directory and environment.
Each failure kind keeps its attempt count and waits only between attempts: none follows the final attempt, including the x-ratelimit-reset wait, which is honored only up to 60 seconds.

Base-branch discovery lists every missing candidate with one exact refs/heads ls-remote and fetches only existing branches in order; a per-branch upstream oracle on a second clone leaves the same remote-tracking refs and base SHA.
A shallow checkout reads a present pull-request head commit without a remote lookup or fetch and still fetches a missing one, with real git.
Package initialization detects no OS metadata; the first accessor does.
macOS reads kern.osproductversion, matches sw_vers on the host and keeps sw_vers with SYSTEM_VERSION_COMPAT or a failed or empty sysctl.
The concurrent execution-metadata store keeps map semantics: pointer keys, replacement on a second create, isolated deletes; concurrent create/read/replace/delete under -race.

Ordered profile parsing and index/key subtraction return the upstream algorithm's blocks, covered files and bitmaps for generated and hand-written profiles; adapters run the ported coverage assertions unchanged.
Indexed known-test lookups return the upstream results, including the known-data flag; a new response gets a new index; one lookup per wrapped test is reused; concurrent indexing under -race.
The first formatted error keeps its caller's stack, including concurrent first errors and process-retry owners; later errors and instrumentSetErrorInfo after a formatted error capture no stack.

local_compatibility_checks.purpose: Pack files fall back to the git directory instead of the working tree, are written there directly when the temporary directory is on another filesystem, and every attempt, empty result and upload removes its temporary directory.
Parallel retry attempts that share the original's lease record their end in testing's parallel-test accounting; the lease owner and sequential attempts record nothing.
TestMiniInProcessRetryKeepsAllocsPerRun builds with ddto's testing overlay and checks that testing.AllocsPerRun works after parallel tests passed at once or retried in process.
The optimized sum fixture must report lines 5-10 with normal, unoptimized and race builds. CLI checks verify Mini selection, runtime flag consumption, log identity and errors before Go starts.
Logs initialization in a fresh process uses os.Hostname and starts no hostname-discovery goroutine for goleak to report.
safe.directory names the checkout root of a repository, a linked worktree or a submodule, whose .git is a file.

The Fuzz/Examples comparator aligns a Mini test.command with the longest SDK command that is its argument prefix, requires Mini's exact form for the fixture invocation and rejects retained volatile flags.
